technical-summary: rad0013: Radiance v1.17.0's qwen4exp pass_key refuses every nonzero MTP draft pass (serial rounds and head history), so they are issued live every speculation round instead of replayed from a recorded tape (v1.16 recorded draft passes -1, 0, 2, 3; v1.17 only 0). The patch keys fixed-geometry pure-decode draft/verify passes by every geometry input and keeps mixed/live-split passes live, fail-closed. Enters the one build as the untested mtp-pass-replay set. Launcher start guard refuses a start with MTP depth above 1 and no recorded draft pass beyond 0. Hardware (four-GPU Flash-Next, two passes): decode step 1.7-2.7% faster on all five accept-bench prompts, text and acceptance bit-identical.
user-summary-candidate: Restores Flash-Next's decode speed lost in Radiance v1.17 (about 2% per step) by replaying speculative draft passes again; outputs are unchanged.
